entity.name: Miami Grand Prix
entity.summary: The Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix runs each spring on the Hard Rock Stadium campus in Miami Gardens, promoted by South Florida Motorsports. It earns from tickets, premium hospitality and sponsorship, with Hard Rock as title partner from 2027.

signals.title: Hard Rock replaces Crypto.com as title sponsor from 2027
signals.summary: Announced Sep 2, 2026, the race becomes the Formula 1 Hard Rock Miami Grand Prix from 2027, with Hard Rock branding on track, paddock, fan-area and podium signage. Crypto.com's title deal ended after the May 3, 2026 race.

signals.title: Paddock Club extension and Beach Club revamp open in 2027
signals.summary: A new three-storey Paddock Club extension overlooking Turns 1 to 3 opens for the 2027 race, making it one of the largest in F1. The Hard Rock-sponsored Beach Club is being revamped for 2027 with track-view cabanas and live performances.

signals.title: Longest-contracted race on the calendar, through 2041
signals.summary: F1 extended Miami through 2041 in May 2025, the longest contract on the calendar. South Florida Motorsports was named 2024 Promoter of the Year.

signals.title: Record crowd of 275,000 in 2024
signals.summary: The 2024 race drew a record 275,000 attendees, up from over 240,000 at the 2022 debut.

signals.title: 2026 race ran May 1-3 with a Sprint
signals.summary: The 2026 race ran May 1-3 in Miami Gardens with the F1 Sprint for a third straight year, plus a headline music program.

signals.title: Brands activated trackside in 2026
signals.summary: 2026 race-week activations included Jack Daniel's trackside with Shaboozey and Loud Luxury, and trackside hospitality from Off Grid and Imperial Moto.

signals.title: F1 runs its own fan-zone QR prize draw in Miami
signals.summary: Formula 1's F1 Unlocked program ran a QR-code prize draw in the fan zone at the 2025 Miami race. Entrants need an F1 Unlocked or F1.com account, and Formula One Management runs the draw.

signals.title: Zoox active at the Miami race
signals.summary: Zoox, a Williams F1 team partner since 2024, is involved with events at the Miami and Austin races, and became the Las Vegas race's official ride-hail partner in Nov 2026.

signals.title: Backed by Stephen Ross, on the Hard Rock Stadium campus
signals.summary: South Florida Motorsports credits Stephen Ross for his investment in the event. The race is held on the Hard Rock Stadium campus, home of the NFL's Miami Dolphins, where Hard Rock has held stadium naming rights since 2016.

opportunities.title: Make every new Hard Rock asset a dynamic code before 2027 production starts
opportunities.whatsHappening: Hard Rock takes the title from 2027, so track, paddock, fan-area and podium signage changes from Crypto.com to Hard Rock branding. The race is contracted through 2041 and drew a record 275,000 fans in 2024.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: A rebrand forces a reprint, which is the cheapest moment to add codes. Flowcodes can be updated after printing, so assets made for 2027 keep working through 2041 instead of being reprinted per campaign. Co-branded codes can route to race and Hard Rock offers, with the promoter's opt-in first. C3 Presents ran this at festival scale with 1.3M+ scans in 2024.
play: Get onto the 2027 signage brief now: wayfinding, fan-area, grandstand and podium-adjacent assets.
Design co-branded Flowcodes with Hard Rock's creative team.
Set routing rules per area and per day: schedule, food and drink, merch, then 2028 presale after the race.
Share a joint dashboard with Hard Rock to prove title-sponsor value.
opportunities.buyer: Miami GP commercial and marketing leads (president Katharina Nowak), with Hard Rock partnership marketing

fit.why: dynamic codes on new physical assets

access.why: promoter owns the signage and is mid-change

caveats: The 2027 race date was not found in sources. Past races ran in early May.
Hard Rock creative approval adds a stakeholder.

opportunities.title: Own the fan relationship in the fan zone, alongside F1 Unlocked
opportunities.whatsHappening: Formula 1 ran its own QR prize draw in the Miami fan zone in 2025, with entries tied to F1 Unlocked or F1.com accounts run by Formula One Management. The race drew a record 275,000 fans in 2024.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Fans who scan for F1's draw become F1's data. Promoter-owned codes with FlowID give South Florida Motorsports its own first-party list for renewals, hospitality and future events. Flowcode reports 75% higher than average first-party conversion in sports and entertainment.
play: Agree placement with F1 so promoter codes sit alongside F1 Unlocked assets, not on top of them.
Offer a promoter-only reward, such as a paddock tour draw or an early presale window, behind a FlowHub opt-in.
Sync opt-ins to the promoter CRM with consent flags.
Track promoter list growth year over year.
kpis: Cost per captured fan vs paid media
opportunities.buyer: Marketing and CRM leads, South Florida Motorsports

fit.why: owned identity is the core product

caveats: Fan-zone placement may be governed by F1 agreements.
The F1 Unlocked evidence is from 2025. Check whether it ran in 2026.

opportunities.title: Fill the new Paddock Club and Beach Club with identified prospects
opportunities.whatsHappening: A three-storey Paddock Club extension overlooking Turns 1 to 3 opens for the 2027 race, one of the largest in F1, and the Hard Rock Beach Club is being revamped with track-view cabanas and live performances.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: New premium inventory needs buyers. Codes in general admission areas and on promotional assets route interested fans to hospitality offers, and FlowID plus CRM sync turn scans into named leads for the sales team instead of anonymous web traffic.
play: Run codes on promotional assets and partner channels now, pointing to 2027 Paddock Club and Beach Club packages.
During 2027 race week, put codes on general admission screens promoting 2028 hospitality.
Score leads by repeat scans and push them to hospitality sales.
Track hospitality revenue influenced by scans.
opportunities.buyer: Premium hospitality sales lead, South Florida Motorsports
caveats: Capacity and price of the new Paddock Club space were not found in sources.

opportunities.title: Cross-sell the race across the Hard Rock Stadium calendar
opportunities.whatsHappening: The race is held on the Hard Rock Stadium campus, home of the Miami Dolphins, and the promoter credits Stephen Ross for his investment. Hard Rock has held the stadium naming rights since 2016 and now also takes the race title.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Fans at Dolphins games and stadium concerts are the nearest audience to the race. One Workspace across the campus lets codes on stadium screens promote race tickets, with attribution back to the event that drove each sale. Flowcode's NFL Shop broadcast spot shows how strong that attribution can be.
play: Validate shared ownership and data-sharing between the stadium, the Dolphins and the race.
Run race promo codes on stadium screens during Dolphins home games and concerts.
Use a separate code per event to see which crowds convert.
Feed results into the 2027 media plan.
kpis: Race tickets attributed to stadium events

timing.window: Remaining Dolphins home games this season
